title: nOS Service Manifest (state/manifest.yml)
description: Public, committed declaration of the expected shape of the system. Consumed by nos_state introspect. See files/anatomy/docs/framework-plan.md §3.1.

container_pattern.description: Default container name pattern for docker-image services. Supports {stack} and {id} placeholders. Default: '{stack}-{id}-1' (Docker Compose project-prefixed convention).

daemons_without_row.description: launchd label -> the ruling for a host daemon no service row owns (body-plan.md §5): a reflex or internal of its owner is a job, not an organ, and gets no graph node; heartbeat keeps its daemon: node at level cross. Every other declared label is a row's launchd_label or launchd_helpers and is that organ.

of.description: The owner: a services[].id, or playbook-core for a tasks/*.yml hook.

software_owner.description: Whose software this organ is (body-plan.md §4.1; same key and values as the host-software default layer, tools/nos_identity.py). self: one of nOS's own parts, code in this repo or a contract-declared sibling. symbiont: declared vendor software beside nOS, fed by its vendor. Habitat is the machine owner's and is never a row. Gate: tests/anatomy/test_manifest_rows_carry_origin.py.

stack.description: Docker compose stack (infra, observability, iiab, apps, devops, b2b, voip, engineering, data) or null for host-native services.

install_flag.description: Name of install_<service> boolean in default.config.yml.

fragment.description: Compose override fragment stem — <stacks_dir>/<stack>/overrides/<fragment>.yml. Defaults to `id`; state it only where they differ (6 rows). null = the service owns no fragment of its own (manifest apps merge into apps/overrides/auto.yml).

image.description: Docker image name (without tag) — for version_source=docker_image.

container_name.description: Explicit single-container override. Takes precedence over nos.container_pattern.

container_names.description: Explicit list of container names for multi-container services (e.g. erpnext, authentik). The first entry is treated as the primary for introspection.

launchd_label.description: The row's main launchd job — the one version_source launchd reads.

launchd_helpers.description: Further launchd jobs the same role starts under the same flag (an exporter, a model server).

host_process.description: For a host-native row (stack null) with no launchd job: what runs instead (a CLI, a desktop app, an sshd ForceCommand).

host_programs.description: Executable basenames the row runs outside launchd (a cask's system extension); tools/undeclared-status.py joins their listeners to this row.

joint.description: Appendage (ssot/doctrine/body-plan.md §4.2): repo path of the cross-repo contract spec this organ is attached through. Gate: tests/anatomy/test_appendage_is_detachable.py.

joint_pending.description: Appendage whose contract is not written yet: why. Tolerated only on the gate's pending list, which may only shrink.
